articles.headline: Amen Thompson stuffs Wemby's last-second shot as Rockets hold off Spurs

article.headline: Atlanta plays Houston for out-of-conference matchup
article.description: Houston Rockets (1-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (2-0, first in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Atlanta plays Houston for out-of-conference matchup
article.linkText: Atlanta plays Houston for out-of-conference matchup
article.story: Houston Rockets (1-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (2-0, first in the Eastern Conference) Atlanta; Saturday, 8:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Hawks -1.5; over/under is 230.5 BOTTOM LINE: Atlanta and Houston square off in non-conference action. Atlanta finished 46-36 overall last season while going 24-17 at home. The Hawks averaged 9.4 steals, 4.7 blocks and 13.4 turnovers per game last season. Houston finished 52-30 overall with a 22-19 record on the road last season. The Rockets gave up 110.0 points per game while committing 18.3 fouls last season. INJURIES: Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). Rockets: Reed Sheppard: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
